entries.zh: 宛如、仿佛；恰似（正如、这样）
entries.en: just as; so, thus; as if, exactly like

entries.zh: 正是这样、恰如其然；这才、方才
entries.en: just so; in such a manner; just now
entries.notes: 「掌才」四栏音读一致但字用非常规，与 como: asi: como（恰如此）的对应依赖推断，疑「正才／恁般」类词。

entries.en: how should I dare?; how could I presume
entries.notes: quy 声调标记污损（T99）且 R 疑 quy/gui；汉字「岂敢」与 como me atreuere? 对应本身明确。

entries.en: what are you called?; what is your name?
entries.notes: 「呌」＝「叫」之异写（R 疑呌/叱）；「也」＝「什么」，句意为问名。

entries.zh: 差人纳福（遣人问安致福的客套语）；亚不＝句末语气词（抑不，好不好）
entries.en: how are you? (polite greeting formula, lit. to send one with blessings)
entries.notes: R 末词受裁切（yag/yap 存疑）、多音节声调 T99 污损，R 疑 xiêgin/xiêguin；释义据问安套语推断。

entries.en: how so?; what can be done?
entries.notes: M 首音节声调 T99 污损，H 疑奈/杂；字面「奈何」与 como que esta? 对应依赖推断。

entries.zh: 几时、何样（什么时候、什么样子）
entries.en: how are you?; when and in what manner
entries.notes: 末音节声调 T99、R 疑 gìn/kin；「伺样」疑为「恁样／怎样」之写。

entries.zh: 贵体好吗（问安客套）；亚不＝句末语气词（抑不）
entries.en: how are you? (lit. is your honorable body well?)
entries.notes: 「几」当为「贵」之音写（R gùi＝贵），「亚不」＝「抑不」语气词（H 疑亚/恶）。

entries.zh: 尊夫人好吗（尊阃安好否）
entries.en: how is your wife? (lit. is your esteemed wife well?)
entries.notes: 「壶」为「阃」之借写（尊阃＝夫人），末词词尾受裁切（yap/yag 存疑）。

entries.en: as you wish; as it pleases you
entries.notes: source_L 疑 Iu/tu，当作 como tú quisieras。

entries.zh: 主张；听凭做主、随你定夺
entries.en: as you wish and at your pleasure (a tu albedrío)
convenience, comfort; fitness, a convenient place
to wail, to cry loudly; to lament
to pity, to compassionate; to feel sorrow for
entries.notes: M 首音节疑 līm/līn（或「怜悯」连读），R 单音节 mièn＝悯。

entries.en: to grieve, to be sorrowful; to pity
entries.notes: 两栏声调标记均 T99 污损；「戚」通「慼」（忧愁），与 compadecerse 对应依赖推断。

entries.en: sorrowful, mournful; piteous
entries.notes: 声调标记 T99 污损（M 双 T99）；「悽」＝凄，悲戚义。

entries.en: to pity one another; to grieve for each other
entries.notes: M 首音节疑 siāng/siō、「痛」声调 T99、L 词尾 ihuiez 存疑；据「相痛」释义。

entries.en: to pity, to compassionate; to take pity on
entries.notes: M 首音节 T99 污损；M 附读 co līn/co līng 疑「可怜」类连读。

entries.en: to grieve, to be saddened; to pity
to ache, to hurt; to grieve, to pity
entries.notes: M 声调 T99 污损；「痛」兼疼惜义与 dolerse 对应，L 疑 dolerse/dllerse。

entries.en: to pity, to compassionate; to relieve, to succor
entries.notes: M 疑 līn/hīn、fīn/hīn，R 疑 hiùn/hùn；「恤」字义明确。
